resources.string:
Tap — A
Hold — B
Double-tap — Start
Tap, then tap and hold on the left half — L
Tap, then tap and hold on the right half — X
Swipe and keep your finger down — Control Stick, in any direction
The swipe also holds the D-pad in its direction: up, down, left or right
Tap, then two-finger tap and hold — Fast-forward (double speed while held)
Two-finger tap, then two-finger tap and hold — Dolphin menu
Three-finger tap — Quick save
Three-finger hold — Quick load

While one finger moves the stick, tap with another finger for A or hold it for B. Fast-forward keeps the sound at normal speed. Quick load only works if you haven't saved in the game since the quick save, so you never end up with two different saves. Game controllers work too.
That doesn\'t look like a GameCube BIOS. A BIOS dump is a 2 MB file usually called IPL.bin.
The GameCube BIOS couldn\'t be installed, so the startup animation is skipped.
The last game is still closing. Press Play again in a moment.
Two-finger tap, then tap and hold, opens the Dolphin menu.
%1$s can\'t be opened any more (moved, renamed or deleted?). Choose the game file again, or pick another version under Mods.
Wait for the current task to finish first.
Turn texture packs on or off without removing them.
Loads every texture when the game starts. Smoother, but needs a lot of memory and slows down booting — leave it off for big packs.
The pack\'s textures are removed from this phone. You can import it again later.
%1$s is installed (%2$d textures). It shows up the next time you start the game.
\n\nThis pack uses DDS textures. If the game still looks the same, your GPU doesn\'t support them: delete this pack and import the PNG version instead.
No Dolphin textures were found. A texture pack contains files named like tex1_….png or tex1_….dds.
This zip can\'t be read here. Extract it with a file manager app, then use “Import extracted folder” and choose the folder inside it named after the game (such as %1$s).
Not enough free space. This needs about %1$s free.
Your phone ran out of free space.
The patched game is removed from this phone. Its saves are kept, so they come back if you install it again.
The game is removed from this list. The file itself stays where it is.
%1$s (clean original) — for new mods and updates
%1$s — for add-ons made for this mod
%1$s is installed and selected. Press Play to start it.
%1$s is added and selected. Press Play to start it.
Your game file is an NKit image (%1$s). Mod patches need the full, clean disc image: convert it back to a 1.46 GB ISO (for example with NKit\'s ConvertToISO) and choose that as your game file.
The patch file seems to be damaged: %1$s. Download it again.
Your game couldn\'t be converted to an ISO.
The patched game can\'t be read by Dolphin.
No quick save yet. Tap with three fingers to make one.
Not loaded: you saved in the game after this quick save.
Not loaded: you saved in the game after this save state.
%1$s is available. You have %2$s.\n\nDownload it (%3$s) and install it now? Installing closes the app, so save your game first.
This build doesn\'t know where its updates are published. Builds from GitHub Actions do.
GitHub didn\'t let the app see the releases (error %1$d). If the repository is private, the build needs an update token (see Updates in the README).
GitHub answered with error %1$d. Try again later.
Can\'t reach GitHub. Check your internet connection and try again.
The downloaded file isn\'t an update for this app.
Android needs your permission for %1$s to install its updates. Turn on \"Allow from this source\", then come back.
Takes effect the next time the game starts.
30 FPS for the next 10 seconds to get the cutscene past the stuck point
